summary: Enlight Renewable Energy Ltd. filed a Form 6-K disclosing that its board authorized management to prepare for a potential expansion of its existing 5% unsecured Series G notes in Israel, targeting approximately NIS 550 million (about $150 million). The offering would be conducted under a shelf prospectus exclusively to Israeli investors and listed on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange. Proceeds would be used for debt refinancing and portfolio investments. Terms are preliminary and subject to further approvals; no definitive commitment exists. This is a routine debt financing consideration, not a special situation.
